values.note: Water and electric $32 a night in peak season (April 1-October 31), $28 off season (November 1-March 31); full hookups $38 / $32. The 13-site equestrian campground, dedicated to riders, is $28 / $25. Every reservable RV site carries a $10 booking fee; CampLife's estimate for a full-hookup site is $48 a night ($38 + $10). The water-and-electric sites (116-175) are first come, first served.

fees.source: https://mozingolake.com/rv-park ('Peak Season ( April 1 – Oct. 31)', 'Off Season (Nov. 1 – March 31)', 'Electric/Water $32/night $28/night', 'Water/Electric/Sewage $38/night $32/night', 'Equestrian RV Campground $28/night $25/night', '*All reservable RV Sites will have a $10 booking fee applied', 'Sites 116-175 offer electricity and water.', 'Sites 101-175 operate on a first-come, first-served basis.'), read 2026-11-07; https://www.camplife.com/1312/reservation/step1 estimates: RV Site 176 and 204 $48, RV Site 313 (equestrian) $38, read 2026-11-07

values.note: 115 RV sites open to any camper: South 95 (101-115 and 176-195 full hookups, 116-175 water and electric) and North 20 (201-220, 30/50A), with 20 more North sites due for reservations in 2027; the 13-site equestrian campground (301-313) is dedicated to riders. The 40 reservable non-equestrian sites are 35-50 ft on CampLife; the operator gives 20-50 ft for the whole park, and the first-come pads on imagery run about 15-20 m.

sites.source: https://mozingolake.com/rv-park ('The South RV Campground consists of 95 sites', 'The North RV Campground consists of 20 sites', 'For equestrian users, a 13-space RV campground is dedicated for use on the west side of the lake', 'Our sites range from 20ft to 50ft long.') + CampLife per-site records (RV Sites 176-195 and 201-220: maxLength 35-50; 301-313: 50), read 2026-11-07

facilities.source: https://mozingolake.com/rv-park ('All RV Campgrounds are equipped with restrooms and a shower house that are cleaned regularly.'; 'Laundry Facilities are located at the South RV Campground in the shower house facility.'; 'All RV sites have Wi-Fi available for use.'; 'The sanitary dump station is located South of Sites 101-105 and North of the shower house.'; 'the new Visitors Center, located at the park entrance, offers additional food, toiletries, and other essentials for purchase'; water hookups at every site), read 2026-11-07

note: City of Maryville park on the roughly 1,000-acre Mozingo Lake, with three RV campgrounds: South (95 sites, on a peninsula), North (20 concrete sites) and a riders' equestrian campground on the west shore. 40 South and North sites are reservable online for up to 14 days; the rest are first come, first served and may stay longer at staff discretion. The South campground and its shower house stay open all winter; the North and Equestrian close from November 1 to March 1. --Claude
summary: Confirmed City of Maryville rates and $10 booking fee; fees base corrected to water/electric $28-32 with full hookups +6 (stored high $38 was the full-hookup rate); site count 128 -> 115 (13 equestrian sites are riders-only), 35-50 ft reservable pads; added flush toilets and potable water. Lakefront confirmed on the South peninsula sites. PIN ~420 m off.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront confirmed (first evidence; the stored waterfront_evidence was only a commit reference): South campground's outer west-side sites on the peninsula loop (map 117-122, beside 152) sit 25-35 m from the riprap shore across open mown grass with picnic tables, no road or day use between (Esri imagery); pads 325.6-326.5 m vs ~322.5-322.9 m at the water (EPQS) - 3.5-4 m above it on a gentle slope. Sites 173-175 at the south spur end sit close to the south shore too. waterfront_evidence: 'Esri imagery + operator map 2026-11-07: South peninsula sites 117-122 25-35 m from the shore over open lawn, pads ~4 m above the lake, no road between'.

PIN: stored 40.3628,-94.7762 is a road junction between the campgrounds, ~150 m from North and ~420 m from the centre of the South campground (95 of the 115 sites). Move to 40.3590,-94.7770 (South RV campground centre on imagery; North loop ~40.3623,-94.7782).

SITES: count 128 -> 115. The 13 equestrian sites are 'dedicated for use' by equestrian users; 128 counted them. Only the 40 reservable non-equestrian sites have measured lengths (CampLife maxLength: 35 ft x1, 40 ft x6, 50 ft x33); the 75 first-come sites (101-175) have none posted - the operator's 20-50 ft range is park-wide, so some may be under 23 ft.

RESERVABLE COUNT in note: the operator says 53 reservable, but 13 of those are the riders' equestrian sites; 40 general sites (176-195, 201-220) book online. CampLife showed no RV site for sale online on 2026-11-10 or 2026-12-08 (off season) - the off-season South sites appear to be first come only.
